D: A reprogrammed Terminator protects young John Connor from the liquid metal T-1000.
P: Serve the mains when the Terminator walks into the biker bar to borrow some clothes.
S: Sarah's old friend in the desert
Flour tortillas warmed on a hot dry pan, filled with refried beans, cheese and salsa, folded.
the drive south to Enrique's camp
Golden shortcrust half moons filled with cumin-spiced beef, chopped boiled egg and green olives, baked until crisp.
M: Skirt steak marinated in lime, garlic and cumin, grilled hot, sliced, in corn tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa roja.
Two thin patties smashed on a smoking griddle, American cheese, pickles and burger sauce (mayo, relish, mustard), wrapped tight in paper.
W: Ridged fried churros rolled in cinnamon sugar with warm chocolate sauce. Boil 250ml water with 30g butter and a pinch of salt, beat in 150g flour and cool, then beat in 1 egg.
K: Blue raspberry cordial blitzed with lots of ice until slushy.

s.note: the drive south to Enrique's camp
s.how: Fry 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp paprika, then stir in 2 chopped boiled eggs and 50g chopped olives. Cut 3 sheets shortcrust pastry into 12 rounds, fill, fold, crimp, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

s.note: Sarah's old friend in the desert
s.how: Warm 8 flour tortillas on a hot dry pan. Spread with a tin of refried beans, sprinkle with 150g cheddar and add a spoon of salsa made from 2 diced tomatoes and a chopped jalapeño. Fold and warm again until the cheese melts.

m.how: Marinate 800g skirt steak in lime, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 2 hours. Soak 3 dried chillies, blitz with a tomato and garlic for salsa roja. Grill the steak hot, slice and serve in 16 corn tortillas with onion and coriander.

w.how: Boil 250ml water with 30g butter and a pinch of salt, beat in 150g flour and cool, then beat in 1 egg. Pipe 10cm lengths into oil at 180C and fry until golden. Roll in sugar and cinnamon and serve with 150g dark chocolate melted into 150ml cream.

d.how: Blitz 200ml blue raspberry cordial with 600ml cold water and 4 cups of ice until smooth and slushy. Pour into four cups and serve straight away with spoon straws before it melts.
